name: Aphelios Flex
summary: An AD opener that bridges into Aphelios when you cannot reach level 9.
playWhen: You have a good AD opener
You cannot bridge the gap to level 9

opener.note: A strong AD opener, usually built around Blossom.

stages.tip: Slam only items the carry or its trait unit will hold later. Otherwise keep components flexible.
Stay on the cheapest board that fits the trait. Decide between this line and the alternative by 3-2, once you know your items.
Level for the carry and tanks, and pivot to a connected comp if your items stop fitting.
